subject.title: fix(release): keep msteams packaging and Docker reruns reliable

question: Should the PR CI sweeper retain an exact Zizmor `github-app` suppression on its two existing full-grant token-minting steps because the required narrower token permissions cannot be minted by these app installations?
rationale: The patch does not broaden credentials, but it intentionally suppresses the static warning that calls attention to the existing broad grant; that tradeoff is a maintainer-owned workflow-security decision.

options.title: Accept the scoped suppression
options.body: Keep the two exact inline ignores and their explanatory comment, with the existing token behavior unchanged.

options.title: Redesign the token path
options.body: Require a different app installation or workflow design that can request and mint the narrower permissions without a scanner exception.

options.title: Pause the workflow annotation
options.body: Land the packaging and artifact-recovery work separately and defer the scanner-baseline change until the token design is decided.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped suppression
recommendation.body: Keep the two exact inline ignores and their explanatory comment, with the existing token behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the proposed release and workflow changes and can provide the operational context for the token-grant limitation.
